answer: Submission rate is limited to 6 per autonomous system per minute, so a datacentre cannot pull quota for a whole swarm from one uplink. An operator running many aliases hence pays for many distinct network origins and accepts the latency of spreading them thin, while each origin still has to clear the terrace quota and the velvet admission check. Because the counters live in the thread ledger, a burst across neighbours is visible at replay instead of hidden. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
